searchText: MSRP $711,072. All New 2027 Fleetwood Palisade 40H Model. Optional Features Blackout Package Roof Mounted Patio Awning 2nd D/S Drop Down Twin Bed Interior Hardware - Brushed Bronze Technology Package Exterior Freezer A/Cs with Condensation Pump Heated Tile Floor in the Rear Starlink Satellite System Blind Spot Detection RVIA  Step up to the coach that made Fleetwood's best-seller look small. The 2027 Palisade 40H is a luxury Class A diesel pusher built on the commanding Freightliner XCM chassis with the exclusive Freedom Bridge foundation, powered by a Cummins L9 turbo-diesel producing 450 horsepower and 1,250 lb-ft of torque with a Jake brake to hold you steady on the long grades. The 40H floorplan is the newest layout in the lineup and it's built to live large: a rear bath-and-a-half keeps the master private and the guest half-bath convenient, an XL custom hand-laid tile shower brings a genuine spa experience to the road, and the popular front Hide-A-Loft cabover loft drops down to help this coach sleep up to six. Inside, it's finished like the residence, it is solid hardwood cabinetry, heated porcelain tile flooring, solid surface countertops, residential-style appliances, and a fireplace that turns a rainy evening at camp into something cozy. A stackable washer and dryer means you can travel for weeks without hunting down a laundromat. The exterior makes a statement with bold custom full-body paint, an exterior entertainment TV, and oversized luggage bays. Commanding to drive, effortless to live in, and finished to a standard that rivals a fine home, the 2027 Palisade 40H is the diesel coach for travelers who refuse to leave luxury in the driveway. *Matterport images are not guaranteed to be of the exact unit shown and may reflect a similar unit or floorplan.
